description: What the hub's company page shows for one company: a one-line summary, the maturity stage of its public AI record (0 Nothing public, 1 Self-reported, 2 Early, 3 In production, 4 At scale, with the rule behind it), documented deployments and how many are in production, AI providers, use-case patterns, the latest deployments with source and hub links, AI uses the company describes on its own website (kept apart, never counted as deployments), the peer comparison, AI hiring where tracked, and the weekly trend calls that touch it. Covers the Fortune Global 500 and every company with a hub page; spelling variants and units are grouped. Use it first for questions like 'how far is Nestle with AI?' or 'what AI does UBS use?'.

company.description: Company name, for example Nestle, UBS or Toyota Motor.
